title: Record 2026 election spending means higher CPMs for advertisers

facts.fact: The eMarketer article 'Record 2026 election spending means higher CPMs for advertisers' was published on 2026-09-17.
A related eMarketer headline reports Oura's acquisition at $625 million, per the site's 'Latest Articles' list dated Nov 10, 2026.
facts.quote: Oura’s $625 million acquisition brings medical care into the wearable experience

facts.fact: Super PACs have committed $390 million in post-Labor Day Senate campaign ad spending, according to data provided by AdImpact (third-party data).
facts.quote: super PACs have committed $390 million in post-Labor Day Senate campaign ad spending, per data provided by AdImpact.

facts.fact: As of September 11, political groups had spent more than $1.7 billion on Senate races across linear TV, streaming, and social.
facts.quote: As of September 11, political groups have spent more than $1.7 billion on Senate races across linear TV, streaming, and social.

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts US political ad spending in 2026 to reach $11.07 billion (vendor forecast).
facts.quote: We forecast $11.07 in US political ad spending this year, up 21.4% from the last midterm cycle

facts.fact: EMARKETER forecasts US political ad spend to make up 2.7% of total US media spend in 2026.
facts.quote: US political ad spend will make up 2.7% of US total media spend this year, per our forecast.

facts.fact: The 2026 US midterm elections were seven weeks away at the time of the article.
facts.quote: The 2026 midterm elections are only seven weeks away
